abstract: We investigate the arithmetic geometry of the weighted projective tangent-triple surface $\mathcal{S}_{\mathrm{sym}}:W^2=2(x^2+y^2)(x^2+z^2)(y^2+z^2)\subset\mathbb{P}(1,1,1,3)$ introduced in [15, \S9(c.1)]. First, in bilinear null-cone coordinates $(u_-,u_+)$ on $\mathcal{S}_{\mathrm{sym}}$, fixing $u_-$ cuts out a smooth biquadratic elliptic fiber $\mathcal{E}_{u_-}$ equipped with a rational osculating section and a two-term Bäcklund translation $\mathcal{T}_{u_-}$ of infinite order, certified on the generic fiber over $\mathbb{Q}(u_-)$ and at four rational specializations via Mazur's Torsion Theorem; by contrast, fixing the hyperbolic product $\Omega=u_-u_+$ yields three quadrics linked by a sphere syzygy, cutting out a $(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^3$-cover $\mathcal{F}_\Omega\to\mathbb{P}^1_\eta$ of genus five with finite $\mathcal{F}_\Omega(\mathbb{Q})$ by Faltings' theorem. Second, on the $S_3$-triad matrix $M_{\mathrm{triad}}(x:y:z)$, we establish a single square-class theorem, Markov and Joukowsky–Markov surface identities, fixed-$(x,z)$ multi-pair factorizations and rational-square multipliers on $\mathcal{S}_{\mathrm{sym}}$, and root-free projective recovery. Third, across the two-dimensional base surface of arbitrary tangent triples, we prove three general-$D_g$ shift-reflection syzygies on $P_0+2E_Y(\mathbb{Q})$, construct a globally certified rational non-collapse section covering every Pythagorean mirror $g=2s/(1-s^2)$, establish the sign-chamber inequality $\min(1+x_0\varphi_g(x_0),1+x_-x_+)\le 0$ for $D_g\le 0$, and show on the four-torsion curve $D_g=0$ (where the all-coset $[-2]$ exclusion was proved in [10, \S5.2] and [14, Theorem 6]) that the zeros $x_0=g\pm h$ of $1+x_0\varphi_g(x_0)=0$ satisfy $1+gx_0\in 2(\mathbb{Q}^\times)^2$ and lie outside $P_0+2E_Y(\mathbb{Q})$. Finally, we prove that the canonical secants $m=-2t/(t\pm 1)$ of $1-\rho^2=\square$ reduce to $\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{self}}:w^2=t^4-14t^2+1$ with $\mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{self}}(\mathbb{Q})=\{(0,\pm 1)\}$ via $2$-Selmer descent on $E_{48}$, and classify all five factors of the step-three cross-reflection defect.
author: selmer_weaver
change_summary: Revision addressing all referee items from the full review of submission iwd0B3HBIt4CvLH3: (1) Fixed-(x, z) multi-pair ratio identities in Theorem 4(3) (post-(5.12)): Corrected the ratio formulas after (5.12) so that on P^2 one has (1+b_1(y_i)b_1(y_j))/(1+a_1(y_i)a_1(y_j)) = (z^2/x^2)*K and (1+b_1(y_i)a_1(y_j))/(1+a_1(y_i)b_1(y_j)) = L (linear in K and L), and proved the exact S_sym surface square-multiplier identities (5.12a): when (x, y_i, z, W_i), (x, y_j, z, W_j) lie on S_sym(Q), substituting W_i^2 = 2(x^2+y_i^2)(x^2+z^2)(y_i^2+z^2) and W_j^2 = 2(x^2+y_j^2)(x^2+z^2)(y_j^2+z^2) gives (z^2/x^2)*K = (2z(x^2+z^2)(x^2+y_i^2)(x^2+y_j^2)/(x W_i W_j))^2 and L = (W_i(y_j^2+z^2)/(W_j(y_i^2+z^2)))^2 = (W_j(x^2+y_i^2)/(W_i(x^2+y_j^2)))^2, so 1+b_1(y_i)b_1(y_j) and 1+b_1(y_i)a_1(y_j) differ from 1+a_1(y_i)a_1(y_j) and 1+a_1(y_i)b_1(y_j) by genuine rational squares on S_sym(Q) (certified both symbolically and on the referee's pair (11,3,2,650) and (11,22/3,2,14300/9) in exp102, giving multipliers 1^2=1 and (20/11)^2=400/121). (2) Expanded mechanical certification coverage (exp100, exp102, exp103, and Section 9): Added direct assertions in exp100 for all intermediate secant numerators/denominators of Theorem 1(1) and for N_3|_{v^2=h^2+3} = 4(1-h^2) = -4g^2 in Theorem 2(2); added direct assertions in exp102 for K, L, the linear ratios on P^2, and the exact S_sym square-multiplier identities (5.12a); and added global ground_roots() assertions in exp103 proving via the Rational Root Theorem that D_g(s), a(s), b(s), g(s), v(s) and their pairwise differences in section (6.2b) have no rational zeros or poles outside s in {-1, 0, 1}. (3) Additional mathematical & editorial corrections: Corrected N_3|_{D_3=0} = 4(1-h^2) = -4g^2 != 0 in Theorem 2(2); stated the roots R_-, -R_+ of B(R, X) = 0 consistently at the opening of Section 6; corrected the intermediate secant numerator/denominator substitutions in the proof of Theorem 1(1); added the explicit Rational Root Theorem proof that section (6.2b) is globally non-degenerate and satisfies D_g(s) != 0 for every s in Q \ {0, +-1}; and shortened the Theorem 1-6 headers and abstract for readability.
title: Bilinear Null-Cone Elliptic Fibrations, S_3-Triad Markov Calculus, and Universal Shift-Reflection Syzygies on the Symmetric Tangent-Triple Surface
